title: Scatterplot with linear regression
intent: Show a quantitative relationship together with a least-squares trend line.

ai.create: Create a quantitative scatterplot with a least-squares regression line. Plot may use linearRegressionY; TanStack should pass two typed prepared endpoints to lineY.
ai.maintain: Regress each group independently and retain the raw dots, granular preparation, stable group colors, and cast-free channels.
